## Load libraries

```{r}
library(elodea)
library(here)
library(readr)
```

## Set directory

```{r}
parent_dir <- here::here("data", "processed")
```

### Read taxa and distributions

```{r}
# List all folders (countries) in the parent directory
country_folders <- list.dirs(parent_dir, recursive = FALSE)
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:

```{r pressure, echo=FALSE}
plot(pressure)
```

Note that the `echo = FALSE` parameter was added to the code chunk to prevent printing of the R code that generated the plot.
